_read_me_first: TEMPLATE. Copy this to tools/secret-patterns.local.json and put the REAL
values in that copy. The .local.json file is gitignored and must never be
committed — it is the one place the actual secrets are written down, and a
scanner for secrets must not itself contain any.
Replace every PUT-THE-...-HERE with a real value. Keep the quotes.
`node tools/scan-staged.js` REFUSES to run while any placeholder remains,
so a half-filled file cannot be mistaken for a clean scan.
Patterns are matched as LITERAL text (git grep -F), not as regular
expressions, so a password containing . or $ is safe to put here.
One line per secret. Add a line whenever a new one comes into existence.
